summary.description:
Data Flow Diagram for U-Space Concept of Operations 4th Edition.
Models the drone airspace management system including flight authorization,
real-time monitoring, geofencing, and coordination with air traffic control.
Includes trust boundaries and entry/exit points for threat analysis.
